entries.mitigation: Swap quickly to Blazing Salamanders and kill them before they reach or empower Kinras. Preserve boss control while the group changes targets.
Tank blocks and handles the Hard Mode volcano deliberately while healer supports the resulting pressure; do not let the mechanic pulse freely through the group.
Read the expanding tremor pattern early and move into clean space rather than trying to cross it late. The related achievement requires nobody to be struck.
Avoid traps and free or support a trapped player immediately so the immobilization does not overlap the next boss or add mechanic.
Move into the safe eye immediately. In the inner library, use the geyser to launch toward the safe area when needed; outside the safe eye the room-wide fire is lethal.
Tank the Behemoth away from the group and burn it as a priority during Fire Storm so its heavy attacks and meteor pressure do not compound the movement check.

entries.entry_name: Gore and Bile Globs — Oxblood the Depraved
entries.mitigation: Control the glob wave. Keep Bile Globs from reaching Oxblood and manage Gore Glob ranged pressure without dragging the boss through the group.
Step out of the slow gas circles early and keep Oxblood facing away from the group while repositioning.
Preserve clear movement lanes and do not trigger traps. Blocking can prevent the stun from some trap interactions, but avoidance is the safer plan.
Interrupt Viccia immediately when she channels the lethal beam on a player. Treat the interrupt as a group responsibility rather than waiting for one specific role.
Keep the boss controlled in melee and interrupt sustained group-damage channels when required. Do not drift so far away that eruption pressure becomes unnecessary raid damage.
Focus summoned Molten Fiends before their ranged fire pressure stacks up, while the tank keeps the Guardian stable.
Move with open arena space and avoid the sweeping Ash Vent fire lines. Hard Mode increases late-fight density, so preserve room and keep the group rotating together.
Destroy Molten Pillars before they consume the room. Use Lyranth's Cold-Flame Infusion efficiently when available to accelerate pillar and add control.
